title: Pharaoh meets the fallen nations in Sheol
description: Pharaoh is brought down to the depths of the earth where he meets the mighty nations Assyria, Elam, Meshech, Tubal, Edom and Sidon, all lying there as uncircumcised, slain by the sword. The fallen heroes speak to him from the depths of Sheol, and Pharaoh takes comfort in seeing that he is not alone in his shame and downfall.
